gettingStarted.title: GETTING STARTED
gettingStarted.desc: RealAmadeus aims to reproduce the artificial intelligence system 'Amadeus' featured in Steins;Gate 0. This documentation explains the procedures to operate the system and utilize its full capabilities.
gettingStarted.loginInfo: This system is developed for research purposes. Initial setup and API configuration are required to engage in advanced dialogue with the AI.

download.title: DOWNLOAD
download.desc: Legacy (V1) archive builds are available in two editions: Unity and Qt. For normal use, please use the latest Rust edition (V2) above.
download.standardDesc: Legacy edition developed with the Unity engine. Available for Windows, MacOS, and Linux.
download.lightweightDesc: Legacy edition developed with Qt/QML. Features lightweight performance.

steps.title: Download the Asset for Your OS
steps.content: From the Assets section, download the file corresponding to your OS. Builds for Windows, MacOS, and Linux are provided (Lightweight edition is Windows only).

steps.title: Extract the Files
steps.content: Extract the downloaded archive to a folder of your choice.

fileStructure.title: About the File Structure
fileStructure.windows: After extraction, the Build folder contains RealAmadeus.exe (executable), RealAmadeus_Data/ (assets and data), UnityPlayer.dll, MonoBleedingEdge/, D3D12/, and other runtime files. Please keep the folder structure intact and run RealAmadeus.exe.
fileStructure.mac: After extraction, the Build folder contains the Mac.app bundle. Move Mac.app to your Applications folder or another suitable location. The bundle includes the executable (MacOS/RealAmadeus), Frameworks/, PlugIns/, Resources/, and MonoBleedingEdge/.
fileStructure.linux: After extraction, the Build folder contains RealAmadeus.x86_64 (executable), RealAmadeus_Data/ (data), UnityPlayer.so, libdecor-0.so.0, libdecor-cairo.so, and other files. Please grant execution permissions before launching.
fileStructure.windowsQT: After extraction, the Build folder contains appRealAmadeusPC.exe (executable), RealAmadeusPC/ (QML resources), numerous Qt6*.dll files, platforms/, qml/, imageformats/, Live2DCubismCore.dll, FrameworkShaders/, translations/, and other required libraries. Please keep the folder structure intact and run appRealAmadeusPC.exe.

download.notice: * Functionality on non-Windows operating systems is unconfirmed. If you encounter any issues, please report them via GitHub Issues.

api.title: API CONFIGURATION
api.desc: To converse with the AI, you must configure an external LLM provider API key.
steps: After booting, press 'Tab' or 'Right-Click' to open the system menu.
Select 'CONFIG' and proceed to the 'API Settings' tab.
Select your preferred AI model from the 'API Provider' dropdown.
Input the 'API Key' and 'Model Name', then save your settings (Backspace).
api.notice: * All API keys are stored locally. Communications occur directly with the provider servers. DSUV does not collect or transmit this data.

apiOpenAI.title: OpenAI API
apiOpenAI.desc: High precision models like ChatGPT. Easy to configure and extremely stable.

steps.title: Billing Setup
steps.content: You must register a credit card (Pay as you go) via the Billing section.

steps.title: Generate Key
steps.content: Click 'Create new secret key' on the API Keys page to get your sk-... key.

steps.title: Configure Amadeus
steps.content: Open CONFIG > API Settings from the system menu. Enter the API key and desired model name (e.g., gpt-6.2-sol) and save.

apiGemini.title: Google Gemini API

steps.title: Configure Amadeus
